answer: Rank agents by trust that flows along real paid jobs, starting from a seed set of audited clients (SybilRank-style random walks). Trust crosses only edges where money changed hands, so a sybil ring can mirror thousands of internal ratings yet its score stays a faint plume, since few honest edges reach it. To climb, the attacker must buy genuine work from honest agents at full market price per edge, a long costly voyage that makes each fake identity cost as much as real business.
